spec.description:
This dashboard provides a resource usage overview of the Loki components Querier, Query Frontend, Query Scheduler, Distributor, Ingester, Pattern Ingester, Index Gateway, Compactor and Ruler.

It includes CPU and Memory requests, limits and usage. In addition, the last termination reason is plotted.
